title: Shifts the family can see
description: A schedule with repeating shifts, days off and a shared family view. The pay calculation uses the terms the person has entered.

blocks.text: When shifts change, a standard working week does not explain when someone is busy. The family needs to know when the person is working and when they are off or able to take part in shared plans.

quote.text: I am a nurse who works here and there in a clinic through the week and jus picked up a local travel job. This keeps me in line with both jobs and activities my grand babies have going on. I’ve used another app for a while but

blocks.text: Create several shift types, place them on dates and allow one duty to be corrected without changing the whole cycle. Show a family member the commitments chosen for them. Pay calculation, if it is needed, should be kept separate, with rates and rules stated explicitly.

Test a real month with a swapped shift. Reflecting the exception and the shared view correctly matters more than supporting every schedule up front. A figure calculated from the terms entered must not look like a payment confirmed by the employer.
